    "Robust reporting and analytics for sales pipeline."

  "cons": [
    "Can feel a bit overwhelming with many features for a pure sales role.",
    "Initial setup and customization required some effort.",
    "Some advanced features are locked behind higher paywalls."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This Account Executive likely found HubSpot CRM to be a capable and comprehensive tool for managing customer opportunities and sales processes. While perhaps slightly less intuitive than their previous product, Pipedrive, for pure pipeline visualization, they appreciated its broader functionality and integration capabilities. The platform provided good value, especially for an SMB, though certain advanced features and customer support experiences might have been inconsistent."
